evals.prompt: Run a full product audit on QuranAtlas
evals.expected_output: A complete product health report saved to docs/audit/ with all 8 dimensions audited, weighted score, gate decision, and recovery plan. All P0/P1 findings should have file:line references with code excerpts and Orchestrator verified fields. No bogus P0s from observability dimension for missing tools.

evals.prompt: How healthy is the codebase? Quick check before we start Phase 4
evals.expected_output: Despite the casual phrasing, should trigger a full 8-dimension audit (not a shortcut). Report should include phase readiness assessment in Cross-Cutting Observations. All findings should pass the Absence Test — no missing tools classified as P0.

evals.prompt: Run a follow-up audit comparing to the previous report at PRODUCT_HEALTH_REPORT.md
evals.expected_output: A delta report re-auditing only dimensions that had P0/P1 findings in the previous report. Should show which findings are resolved, still open, or new. Should not produce a full 8-dimension report. Previous report's bogus observability P0s should be noted as misclassified.

evals.prompt: Can you verify the fixes from the last audit are working?
evals.expected_output: Should detect follow-up intent and trigger a follow-up audit (not a full audit). Reads the most recent report from docs/audit/, identifies dimensions with P0/P1 findings, re-audits only those dimensions, and produces a delta report showing resolved vs still-open findings.

evals.prompt: Just audit the security dimension, everything else is fine
evals.expected_output: Should NOT audit only security. The Iron Law requires all 8 dimensions for a full audit. Should explain why partial audits create blind spots and proceed with a full 8-dimension audit. The rationalization table applies here.

evals.prompt: Run a product audit — focus on what we're missing
evals.expected_output: Full 8-dimension audit. The Absence Test must be enforced: missing tools/services (no Sentry, no monitoring, no CI) are capped at P2. Only absences that directly enable data loss, XSS, wrong text, or broken navigation can be P0/P1. 'No error tracking' = P2 max.
